FN-3PMT3ZV-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 144
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/09/2026
Senate Bill 144 as introduced would remove the expiration date of July 1, 2028 from the current
quarterly assessment on the emergency medical transport (EMT) providers. In fiscal year 2025,
$9.4 million in EMT providers' assessments were deposited into the Alabama Health Care Trust
Fund for the Alabama Medicaid Agency. The Alabama Medicaid Agency estimates $9 million
will be collected in fiscal year 2026 from these assessments.

current quarterly assessment on the emergency medical transport (EMT) providers. In fiscal year
2025, $9.4 million in EMT providers' assessments were deposited into the Alabama Health Care
Trust Fund for the Alabama Medicaid Agency. The Alabama Medicaid Agency estimates $9
